description: Defines the Http2HeaderBlock class, a key-value map for storing SPDY/HTTP2 headers with insertion order preservation, including internal classes for header value management and iteration.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock
classes.description: A key-value map for SPDY/HTTP2 headers that preserves insertion order and manages header values efficiently.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::HeaderValue
classes.description: Represents a fragment of a header value, supporting appending and size estimation.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing header entries, supporting forward iteration and dereferencing.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::ValueProxy
classes.description: Proxy object for accessing and modifying header values associated with a key.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::erase
methods.description: Removes headers with the specified key.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::clear
methods.description: Clears all headers and frees associated memory.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::insert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a header entry.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::AppendValueOrAddHeader
methods.description: Appends to an existing header value or adds a new header.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or creates a header value proxy for a given key.
